description: This file implements a Krisp noise reduction audio filter for the Pipecat project, including a singleton manager for the Krisp processor, the filter class itself, and methods for starting, stopping, and processing audio frames.

classes.name: KrispProcessorManager
classes.description: Singleton manager for KrispAudioProcessor instances, ensuring only one instance exists.

classes.name: KrispFilter
classes.description: Audio filter class that applies Krisp noise reduction technology to audio streams.

methods.name: get_processor
methods.description: Returns a shared KrispAudioProcessor instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KrispFilter with optional sample type, channels, and model path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the Krisp processor with the given sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up the Krisp processor when stopping.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies Krisp noise reduction to the provided audio bytes.
